claim: On v3 detecting-insults, opus on aggregator alone (with sonnet on all other 8 roles) DOES NOT fix the schema gate. Pipeline ran to completion at $9.50 with invalid_submission (missing Comment column). Combined with the prior X231 result (opus-designer alone also failed), no SINGLE-role lift — at the haiku→sonnet level (X217/X218 designer/coder), the sonnet→opus level (X231/X232 designer/aggregator), or the haiku→sonnet-everywhere level (X219) — bridges detecting's schema gate. The Phase 1 opus-everywhere $341.83 gold is the only known working configuration. The schema gate is multi-role opus, OR opus-coder specifically.
